name: Testing and Identification of Plastic Materials

units.title: Introduction
topics: Basic concepts of testing-specifications and standards- purpose of specifications-basic specification format-ion and short term testing of plastics

units.title: Mechanical properties
topics: Introduction to stress-strain curves- understanding of terms like stress
etc. • Tensile tests with test specimen preparation and conditioning
factors affecting the test results. • Flexural tests with apparatus
etc. • Compressive properties - creep tests like tensile and flexural creep

creep curves and their study calculations of maximum fiber stress - interpretation and applications of creep data-isochronous stress -strain curves- stress relaxation-stress-time curves and application. • Impact tests like— Izod and Charpy
Tensile impact tests. • Shear strength and abrasion resistance tests in detail. • Fatigue resistance tests: flexural fatigue
factors affecting test results and applications. • Hardness tests: Rockwell hardness
barcol hardness tests with factors affecting test results and limitations. • Creep-stress relaxation • Influence of temperature on modulus

units.title: Thermal properties
topics: Introduction-tests for elevated temp performance-short term tests like HDT, Vicat softening point- torsion pendulum test-long term tests like heat resistance test-all temp index-creep modulus/creep rupture tests-test variables and limitations of all tests with test procedure-specimen preparation, etc
Thermal conductivity and thermal expansion test-coefficient of linear thermal expansion-brittleness temp. etc

units.title: Electrical properties
topics: Introduction-tests like dielectric strength- dielectric constant-dissipation factor-surface and volume resistance- arc resistance-test procedures with specimen preparation in detail

units.title: Weathering properties
topics: Introduction-accelerated weathering tests like exposure to carbon arc lamps-exposure to xenon arc lamps- exposure to fluorescent UV lamps-outdoor weathering of plastics

units.title: Optical properties
topics: Introduction to refractive index-light transmittance and haze-photo elastic properties-color-gloss-tests for each of these

units.title: Material characterization tests
topics: Melt index test in detail-capillary rheometers test with (1) melt viscosity v/s. shear rate curves (2) shear stress v/s. shear rate curves- viscosity tests in detail-GPC- thermal analysis tech .like DSC, TGA, TMA

units.title: Plastic identification
topics: various tests for thermoplastics and thermosets- flame tests-solution test- density measurement-plastic film identification-selection of plastics-criteria and application

units.title: Flammability tests
topics: Incandescence resistance test-ignition properties-oxygen index test-surface burning characteristics-smoke generation tests

units.title: Chemical properties
topics: solvent stress cracking resistance and ESCR tests in detail
